signals.entity: Central Bank of the Republic of Kosovo (BQK)
signals.signal: AWARDED: BQK 'TIPS Clone Connectivity Services', ref BQK-26-014-211, RFB under World Bank Kosovo Financial Sector Development Project (P507659/P507881). WINNER: NEXI Payments SPA (Italy), final contract price EUR 685,000.00, duration 120 days + 5 years maintenance. Contract award notified 03/06/2026, published 12/08/2026. Only other bidder S.W.I.F.T. SC bid EUR 301,138.00 but was rejected as non-responsive (Section IV bidding forms not completed).
signals.implies: Kosovo is building a TIPS clone (a national instant-payment system cloned from the ECB TARGET Instant Payment Settlement platform). Nexi now owns the connectivity layer. Printec's payments-modernization line (ISO 20022 / instant payments) is locked out of the core, but the downstream bank-side work is open.
signals.followup: Map which Kosovo commercial banks must now connect to the TIPS clone and sell instant-payment channel/gateway work to them.

signals.entity: Central Bank of the Republic of Kosovo (BQK)
signals.signal: AWARDED: 'Technical support on implementation of the Fast Payment Infrastructure - TIPS Clone and Overlay Services in Kosovo', RFP BQK-26-011-211, CQS method. WINNER: Paylume SRL, Quai du Commerce 7, 1000 Brussels, Belgium. Contract price EUR 295,000.00, 10 months. Award notice dated 22/07/2026. Sole EOI submitted.
signals.implies: Consulting/PMO layer of Kosovo's instant-payment build now with Paylume. Together with the Nexi connectivity award this fixes the Kosovo instant-payments stack for ~5 years.
signals.followup: Track the overlay services scope for bank-side softPOS / request-to-pay opportunities.

signals.entity: Central Bank of the Republic of Kosovo (BQK)
signals.signal: CANCELLED: open procedure 'Mirëmbajtja teknike e makinës procesuese të keshit' (technical maintenance of the cash-processing machine), Nr. BQK 26 057 221. Only 1 bid received and it was judged non-responsive; cancelled 10/08/2026 under Art. 47 of the BQK Procurement Rule. This is the baseline item that closed 16/07/2026 - it did NOT result in an award.
signals.implies: Direct cash-automation service opening: a re-tender is near-certain and only one bidder showed up last time. Printec's managed/field services + banknote-processing (Glory/Consillion) service capability fits.
signals.followup: Watch bqk-kos.org/shpalljet/tenderet/ for the re-tender; contact prokurimi@bqk-kos.org for the tender dossier and the installed machine make/model.

signals.entity: Central Bank of the Republic of Kosovo (BQK)

signals.implies: Small but first-class competitor datapoint: Panamic ICT LLC is now the BQK cash-processing consumables supplier and is a likely bidder on the cancelled cash-machine maintenance re-tender.
signals.followup: Profile Panamic ICT LLC (Kosovo business registry) for Agent 6 competitor mapping.

BQK 26 061 111. 2 bids received, both judged non-responsive; cancelled 24/08/2026.

signals.entity: Centralna banka Crne Gore (CBCG, Central Bank of Montenegro)
signals.signal: OPEN, TOP CASH-AUTOMATION ITEM: EU-funded open tender 'Supply of the vault/cash operations equipment for strengthening institutional capacity of the Central Bank of Montenegro', procedure ref EC-ENEST/TGD/2026/EA-LOP/0101, published on the European Commission Funding & Tenders portal, offers due 07/10/2026. Scope as reported: a 'South Lift + Table + Vacuum packer' system, a coin-sorting machine, a banknote sorting-and-banding machine, a desktop banknote sorter, a desktop coin counter and a compact coin scale, plus counterfeit-euro protection and gold testing. Estimated value NOT disclosed in the notice. This is a RE-ISSUE: an identical tender ref EC-ENEST/TGD/2026/EA-LOP/0005 was announced 03/02/2026 and no reason for the re-launch was given.
signals.source_name: Investitor.me (Montenegrin business press) reporting the EU F&T portal notice
signals.implies: Direct hit on Printec's cash automation & recycling line (Glory / Sesami / Consillion banknote and coin counting/sorting) plus the vacuum/shrink packing adjacency. A central-bank reference in Montenegro would also anchor the commercial-bank market. The first attempt failing suggests either a spec problem or too few bidders - a well-prepared bid has a real chance.
signals.followup: Pull the full tender dossier from the EU Funding & Tenders Portal under ref EC-ENEST/TGD/2026/EA-LOP/0101 and compare the technical spec with the failed EA-LOP/0005 attempt; contact CBCG procurement.

signals.implies: Montenegro is on the same TIPS-clone path as Kosovo and North Macedonia. The NSP gate (SWIFT/Nexi only) closes the core, but naming and launching a national instant-payment brand means every Montenegrin bank will need channel, softPOS and request-to-pay work in 2027.
signals.followup: Ask CBCG's Technical Service Unit who won TIPSC-9858-ME-NC-RFB-25-2.12; map the Montenegrin bank-side connection work.

signals.entity: BiH public-procurement portal (ejn.gov.ba) - market structure finding
signals.signal: ZERO RESULT, STATED AS A FINDING: a full-text search of the BiH e-Procurement portal for 'bankomat' (ATM) over 01/01/2025-27/08/2026 returns total=0 notices. No ATM, recycler or self-service tender exists anywhere in the BiH public feed. The only ATM-adjacent BiH public buying is POS acquiring SERVICES (bank card-acceptance contracts): JP Medjunarodni aerodrom Tuzla 'Nabavka bankarskih usluga - POS terminali' notice 527-7-2-149-3-46/26 (16/06/2026, corrected 25/06/2026); KJKP Toplane-Sarajevo 'Prihvat placanja putem POS terminala' JN 01/2026 awarded 05/05/2026; and Lutrija BiH 'POS terminali za klasicne igre' awarded 05/01/2026 (the only POS HARDWARE buy) [STANDING - dated 2026].
signals.source_name: BiH Public Procurement Portal announcement search API
signals.implies: BiH commercial banks are private and buy ATMs outside any public feed - the portal is useful for post/utility/lottery cash equipment and for CIT, not for bank ATM demand. Printec must work BiH banks directly rather than watch the portal.
signals.followup: Build a direct BiH bank contact map (UniCredit BiH, Raiffeisen BiH, Intesa Sanpaolo Banka BiH, NLB, ASA Banka, Sparkasse) instead of monitoring ejn.gov.ba for ATM demand.

signals.entity: Kosovo instant-payments programme (BQK) - regional pattern
signals.signal: DEDUP/PATTERN NOTE: three separate TIPS-clone procurements are running in parallel in the Western Balkans in 2026 and must not be merged - Kosovo BQK-26-014-211 connectivity AWARDED to NEXI Payments SPA at EUR 685,000 (12/08/2026) and BQK-26-011-211 overlay consulting AWARDED to Paylume SRL at EUR 295,000 (22/07/2026); Montenegro CBCG TIPSC-9858-ME-NC-RFB-25-2.12 connectivity (World Bank P509405, closed 28/11/2025, award not published) plus ToR TIPSC-9858-ME-CS-CQ-25-1.6 for the instant-payment marketing/UX strategy; North Macedonia NBRM ESJN notice 14505/2026 connectivity, OPEN until 18/09/2026. All three are World-Bank- or EU-financed and all restrict the connectivity layer to a TIPS-authorised network service provider (SWIFT or Nexi).
signals.source_name: BQK, CBCG and ЕСЈН primary notices
signals.implies: A footprint-wide instant-payments programme across AL/XK/ME/MK is now funded and moving. The central-bank core is closed to Printec, but every commercial bank in three countries must connect, reconcile and expose instant payments in 2027 - the largest Western Balkan payments-modernization pull in years, and the natural entry for softPOS, request-to-pay and channel work.
signals.followup: Build a 2027 instant-payments bank-side offer for XK/ME/MK; identify which local integrators Nexi and Paylume are subcontracting.

coverage_notes: Covered this run: Bank of Albania own tender pages (all 13 live notices read, deadlines extracted); TEB Sh.A. Kosovo tender PDFs (full list downloaded and text-extracted); BQK Kosovo tender/award/cancellation register (19 pages, page 1 read in full, 2026 award and cancellation PDFs extracted); Central Bank of Montenegro 'Tenderi i oglasi' page + RFB/ToR PDFs, plus the EU-funded vault/cash-equipment tender via press; North Macedonia ESJN (e-nabavki.gov.mk) NBRM contracting-authority announcement and concluded-contract grids, plus keyword sweeps of the national current-notices grid in Macedonian (банкомат, банкнот, готовин, ПОС, платежн - all nil for ATM/cash machines); BiH ejn.gov.ba full announcement-search API in Bosnian/Serbian/Croatian (bankomat, novca, novcanic, brojanje, POS terminal, elektronski potpis). PRODUCT CATEGORIES WITH NOTHING THIS RUN in these five markets: (1) ATM & cash automation/recycling - no ATM tender anywhere in AL/BA/XK/ME/MK public feeds ('bankomat' = 0 hits in BiH since 2025; nil in MK current notices); (2) self-service kiosks & branch transformation - nothing; (3) POS/acquiring/TMS/softPOS - only POS ACQUIRING SERVICE contracts in BiH, no terminal-fleet or TMS buys; (10) card issuing & personalisation - nothing; (12) core & digital channels - nothing. CATEGORIES THAT DID SHOW: (1)/(cash processing peripherals) via CBCG Montenegro, BH Post, BQK consumables, Bank of Albania banknote packaging; (4) payments modernization - the three-country TIPS-clone wave; (5) digital identity/e-signature - TEB 270/26 and BQK's cancelled centralised access-management project; (7) compliance/document management - TEB 257/26 and 311/26, Bank of Albania scanning-systems maintenance; (8) physical ATM/branch security - Bank of Albania security-systems maintenance, NBRM CCTV upgrade, Banja Luka cash-room CCTV, TEB monitoring room; (11) managed services / CIT - Hrvatska posta Mostar framework, NBRM money-transport insurance. Explicit market-structure findings: commercial banks in AL/BA/ME/MK are private and publish nothing, so their ATM and POS demand is invisible to every portal searched - the only commercial-bank window in the region is TEB Sh.A. Kosovo, which publishes invitations but never winners. Albania has no public tender-notice search (app.gov.al is the policy site; bid.app.gov.al is login-gated), so the Bank of Albania's own pages remain the only route and it publishes no award notices at all.
access_issues: bqk-kos.org: Cloudflare interstitial, 403 to curl AND to WebFetch even with a desktop Chrome User-Agent; DEFEATED by driving a real browser (Claude Browser pane) - and note that /wp-content/uploads/*.pdf on that host ARE directly curl-able once the filename is known, so the pattern is: browser for the listing, curl+pdfminer for the PDFs. nbrm.mk: same Cloudflare interstitial, 403 to curl with a desktop UA; DEFEATED by the real browser. The NBRM procurement page itself is only an iframe wrapper - the data lives at e-nabavki.gov.mk/InstitutionGridData.aspx#/ciAnnouncementsGrid|ciContractsGrid/a8a22563-cb03-4371-83fc-4c46e74d8964 (that GUID is NBRM's institution id). www.ejn.gov.ba: the announcement search is an Angular app whose POST /api/Announcement/Search returns 401 to curl and to a plain in-page fetch; it needs the X-JsonRequestVerificationToken header the app sets. Worked around by hooking XMLHttpRequest in the live page to capture that header, then replaying the search with arbitrary keywords. next.ejn.gov.ba and api.next.ejn.gov.ba expose no public announcement API. www.cbcg.me: /e/ locale paths 404; only /me/... works. cbcg.me publishes no procurement award notices. www.bankofalbania.org: 403 to the default fetch UA, 200 with a desktop Chrome UA (confirmed again). Its tender list is paginated via a ?crd= query the plain fetch could not follow, so only page 1 (10 of 13 notices) plus targeted detail pages were read.
